top_signals.title: Paramount Closes Warner Merger in Historic Hollywood Deal
top_signals.summary:
Paramount Skydance Corp. closed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc., combining two of the five largest Hollywood film studios and uniting major franchises such as Harry Potter and Mission Impossible.
The new company, called Skydance, will be home to dozens of TV networks and two major subscription streaming services, Paramount+ and HBO Max, and will be led by David Ellison and Ynon Kreiz as co-chief executive officers. Bloomberg's Hannah Miller joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: IPO Market Stalls Four Months After SpaceX's $75 Billion Debut
top_signals.summary: It was hoped SpaceX’s blockbuster June flotation would add rocket boosters to the global IPO  market. But four months on, momentum has come crashing back down to earth. Wall Street IPOs have slowed considerably since Elon Musk’s $75bn (£56.7bn) listing, damaging what was once expected to be a quarter chock-full of floats. Smart-ring maker Oura was the latest company to stall its listing just last week, while data centre company SB Energy, petrol station empire EG Group and nuclear energy firm Holtec have all also postponed.…
